summary: First Citizens BancShares filed an 8-K after establishing a new Series F 7.500% Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock via certificate of designation filed September 11, 2026, with $100,000 liquidation preference per share. Under a September 9, 2026 underwriting agreement with Morgan Stanley, BofA Securities, J.P. Morgan and Wells Fargo as representatives, the company agreed to sell 300,000 depositary shares, each a 1/100th interest in Series F, implying $300 million gross. Series F ranks pari passu with Series A, B, C, D and E preferred. Watch pricing, over-allotment and regulatory capital treatment.
